title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
authors: Zijian Zhang, Rizhen Hu, Jiangweizhi Peng et al.
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains.
